race.comment: CHARLECOTE MILL (9) is fitter for three run form a let-up and last time put the writing on the wall, storming home to finish runner-up behind VISION THING. No better off at the weights, but has the senior rider and looks tough to stop again. VISION THING (10) raced on pace and was a dominant winner last time, with 2.5 lengths on CHARLECOTE MILL. Meets the runner-up a fraction better and can give a sight again. BRUZANI (1) was a winner three back then placed last two. Racing well and expected to be very competitive. ASTRODEAN (5) was poor last time in town in Adelaide but will find this easier and can make amends. ON THE MAP (11) has the blinkers added and shapes as one of the key chances.
